answer: Honest operators gain nothing by splitting, while attackers burn capital they can never recover. Sybil resistance through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a stake that grows with every reputation slot it registers, so the cost of running N fake participants scales superlinearly. It is less a fable of easy anonymity than a marble ledger, each bond hardened by time, and the ocean of fake identities shrinks as registration fees compound against them. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
